subject: Tapinarof
evidence: Tapinarof (3,5-dihydroxy-4-isopropylstilbene) is the first-in-class nonsteroidal, topical AHR agonist (Kd: 100–200 nM) that was approved by the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) in 2022 for the treatment of plaque psoriasis and in 2024 for the treatment of atopic dermatitis.
